dos.title: Wear a pedestrian reflector (helkur) at night
dos.description: Estonian law strictly mandates wearing a reflector on your coat in dark or winter conditions; police actively issue fines.

dos.title: Respect personal space and quiet demeanor
dos.description: Estonians value privacy and modest vocal tones; maintain respectful quietness on public transport and in saunas.

dos.title: Embrace digital payments everywhere
dos.description: Cash is virtually obsolete in Estonia; contactless phone payments and cards work even at remote berry stands.

donts.title: Don't attempt unauthorized drone flights in Tallinn Old Town
donts.description: Tallinn city center and Toompea government zones are strictly regulated no-fly zones requiring CAA permits.

donts.title: Don't enter saunas with swimwear if traditional
donts.description: In traditional Estonian smoke saunas, swimwear is replaced with a clean towel; rinse thoroughly before entering.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping is appreciated but not mandatory; 10% in full-service restaurants is standard for attentive service.
